mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (board_id, user_id, nickname, password, content, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{content}, #{ipAddress}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id AS boardId, user_id AS userId, nickname, password, content, ip_address AS ipAddress, created_at AS createdAt FROM comments WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
